judged.label: answered

judged.label: answered

judged.answer_quote: For example, EVs have to increase in the future. So that will help ASPs.

judged.label: answered

judged.answer_quote: we are looking at a INR14,000 crores capex for the full year. On the inventory, no, I don't think we have a significant increase.

judged.label: answered
